endorsements.name: Paul Haas
endorsements.label: Advanced Format String Attacks
endorsements.description: Format string attacks remain difficult in both software and hackademic exercises as the techniques have not improved since their discovery. This session demonstrates advanced format string attack techniques designed to automate the process from creation to compromise as well as incorporate those techniques into the Metasploit framework. The audience is encouraged to bring a basic understanding of format string attacks in order to leave the presentation with the tools necessary to never write one again.
